pcs.pc_description: set up and install loom appropriately for effective weaving
needs to have very good knowledge on the warp settings / required tuft cloth and tensions thereon
understand buyers defined and implied requirements for quality and product conformity
should be able to read the design by the map and guide the weavers where necessary
collect all information needed for planning of production schedule like carpet design, shade card, yarn types, knots, knot density, etc
identify and highlight constraints affecting planning, production, quality and target delivery
check yarn lot and correct usage of shade as per design particulars
check design received matches with loom size, warp width etc.
check marking on design is clearly indicated and not broken/split etc.
select threads for knotting as per shade and yarn particulars indicated on design sheet
identify different types of faults likely to be encountered during weaving
check knots/inch as per design indicated
process flow of weaving department with stages and significance of defined schedules
monitor needs for productivity and quality as per timelines
margins to be taken during weaving to prevent shortage of size
